During the 2024 season, Peterson earned a career-high score of 38.675 in the all-around and a career-high beam mark of 9.775. Her Level 10 team won the Minnesota state championship, while she placed second in the all-around and on bars, beam and floor. In 2023, she was fourth on bars, ninth on beam and eighth in all-around at Nationals. Peterson was a 2023 state beam champ and placed second on vault, first on bars and second in all-around at regionals.
